definitions.explanation: Describes something that has no apparent end or limit, either literally (in physical extent) or figuratively (in duration, scope, or intensity).

examples.japanese: {果|は}てしない⟦{大地|だいち}→大地：12187_daichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
{果|は}てしない⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。

⟦{宇宙|うちゅう}→宇宙：01861_uchuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{果|は}てしない{広|ひろ}がり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{想像|そうぞう}する→想像する：06060_souzousuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小|ちい}ささ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: When I imagine the boundless expanse of the universe, I feel how small I am.

notes:
Derived from ⟦{果|は}てる→果てる：28565_hateru⟧ (to end, to be exhausted) + ⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧ (not). Literally 'does not end.' Despite being formed from a verb, it functions as an i-adjective and modifies nouns directly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {果|は}てしない⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧: an endless journey
- {果|は}てしない⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧: an endless debate
- {果|は}てしない⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧: endless effort
- {果|は}てしない{広|ひろ}がり: boundless expanse
- {果|は}てしなく⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to continue endlessly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{終|お}わり→終わり：01361_owari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: never-ending — more everyday and conversational; {果|は}てしない is more literary and evocative
- {限|かぎ}りない: limitless, boundless — very similar; slightly more formal
- ⟦{永遠|えいえん}→永遠：01873_eien⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: eternal — focuses on time; {果|は}てしない can apply to space, time, or abstract concepts
- ⟦{際限|さいげん}→際限：14535_saigen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: unlimited — more formal; often used for quantities or processes
